02 / A LITTLE ABOUT ME

Learning today.
Creating tomorrow.

I’m Suhas T.K., a Computer Science & Engineering student, AI video content creator and technology enthusiast who loves turning ideas into experiences. I create AI-powered visual stories and experiment with digital storytelling, while strengthening my programming and software-development skills. I’m currently building a Viva Simulator designed to help students practise viva questions, test their understanding and gain confidence before exams. As a Google Student Ambassador, I’m excited to connect people with technology, share what I learn and grow through collaboration. My approach is simple: stay curious, build consistently, learn from feedback and use technology to solve meaningful problems.
